authorization: Final review and corrections explicitly requested by user after v5 historical diagnosis. No prospective decisions exist yet.
amendment: Operational review v6: crash-released OS lock, complete slot accounting, explicit failed-run status. Same training, scorer, universe, costs, schedule and public-only scope. Preserve v4 records under their original profile; use a new v6 data directory.
model: Unchanged v2 payoff_summary and training-only kNN200 geometry, 8 delayed features, fixed repaired 2021-2023 training observations including censored cases. No historical evaluation, refit, parameter search or tuning from this pilot.
universe: All currently TRADING, spot-enabled Binance USDT symbols, with no original 240-symbol cap and no ranking by past outcome for inclusion. Keep declared non-crypto/stable exclusions plus RLUSD and explicit leveraged-token identification. BTC may itself be a candidate. Every candidate must still have the same 90 complete delayed daily bars and median quote volume >=5 million USDT. Asset classification and coverage are not globally certified. Other exchanges/quotes remain outside the current adapter, not prohibited by user preference.
feature_contract: Monday 00 UTC anchor; exactly 90 consecutive positive complete daily bars ending Saturday. Use extract_features with the same full-day delay. Actual source retrieval known_at must precede committed decision. Live acquisition finishes within entry window; otherwise record MISSED, never backdate or use a Monday open after observing later prices.
selection: Require at least 10 eligible samples; rank strictly positive fixed payoff scores, symbol tie-break, at most five with 20% initial research weight each. Unused allocation is zero-yield USDT reference cash. Preserve both qualified model candidates and final selections. No purchase instruction.
entry_mark: Commit decision to a hash-linked local append-only ledger and fsync it BEFORE requesting any entry book. Then record read-only public depth ask VWAP for 1000 USDT gross simulated notional per candidate. No actual fills. Quote age is bounded by request round trip and request time only; REST book has no per-level timestamp. Fail on slow requests, insufficient visible depth or invalid prices. Record only the hypothetical selected portfolio; no BTC or basket reference portfolio.
outcome: Due at the next Monday 00 UTC, allowing up to 60 minutes for actual retrieval. Fetch exit depth and use bid VWAP for the recorded quantity. Never choose a price retroactively. If entry or due observation is missed, suspended, unpriced, or outside the window, censor the affected outcome. Keep its weight and reason. No symbol migration is assumed without a separately recorded official identity event. An unresolved component makes the portfolio return null; never silently renormalize survivors.

costs.book_cost: Spread and displayed depth impact measured only at observation; additional slippage scenarios do not relabel them as actual realized costs.

events: Save complete current public exchangeInfo response, diffs against prior observation and attempts to retrieve official delisting/update announcements with observed known_at. A successful page is not evidence of complete event coverage. Public event-feed completeness remains UNKNOWN unless separately audited. Missing notices block executable readiness, not read-only observation. Historical BTT/CVP/VIDT remain censored until an exact-horizon exit is verified.
economic_reference: No external investment benchmark. Compare only the same portfolio starting and ending value after costs. USDT marks and eventual BRL economic profit must be labeled separately until conversion and tax route are verified. User delegates venue selection for research; do not keep asking them to choose a benchmark or a preferred exchange.
evidence: Twelve prospective slots test recorder operation and generate new observations; not automatic proof of profit. Already-consumed v5 historical diagnostic has 140 cash weeks and no selected holdings.
stopping_rule: Do not change the model when it abstains or loses. No significance testing during the 12 slots; report descriptive marks and missingness. After last due slot stop the recurring pilot and report feasibility, candidates, costs and unresolved gates. Operational bug fixes must be versioned before later decisions; preserve all prior ledger records.
scheduler: Update the existing thread heartbeat, preserving weekly timing and notification preferences. Use this v4 protocol and a separate v4 data directory; first future anchor and last due anchor unchanged.
mark_fee_accounting: For a hypothetical 1000 USDT budget, consume displayed asks; deduct assumed 10bps buy fee from acquired base quantity. Additional slippage stresses are quantity haircuts. Exit consumes displayed bids and deducts assumed 10bps sell fee and the extra slippage haircut from quote proceeds. Daily v2 neighbor-score cost algebra remains frozen; book-mark accounting is a distinct declared observation proxy. Lot-size rounding, account restrictions and tax are not certified.
synthetic_control_plan: Seed 20260907: fixed 1600-observation two-cluster kNN200 positive/negative geometry control over 80 weeks, one censored-neighbor guard, 100 stipulated zero-log-drift week-common-shock replicates (two candidate queries each). Report qualification count without interpreting it as general null calibration. Conditional planning grid uses absolute annual net-return scenarios 1/5/10/20%, weekly log standard deviations 1/3/5% and dependence multipliers 1/4, against zero net profit. These are planning assumptions, not user targets, forecasts or an external comparison. An arbitrarily small positive edge has no fixed finite detection horizon.

economic_objective.acceptance: Ending value exceeds starting value after all applicable costs, in the same currency. Do not require beating Selic, BTC, a basket or any external investment.
economic_objective.unknown_costs: Public book marks use stated fee/slippage scenarios. Account commission, conversion and taxes are not certified. Missing costs are unknown, not zero; a partial USDT mark is not certified net BRL investor profit.

venue_policy: No user-imposed venue preference. Agent may choose public research venues by suitable data, liquidity and all-in costs. Current tested adapter is Binance public spot only; permission to research other venues is not a claim of implemented worldwide coverage or account accessibility.

operational_review.locking: Persistent observer.lock metadata file with OS advisory lock. Process death releases the lock; file existence alone is not a running process. Do not delete it while another process might run.
operational_review.accounting: Each weekly selection uses a new fixed 5000 USDT sizing reference. Status sums completed-week hypothetical P&L and reports missing due slots separately; whole-pilot sum remains null until every slot is known. No compounded account equity or actual investor profit claim.
operational_review.retrospective_outcome: 0 selected holdings in 140 weeks, 0 simulated return; no trading evidence. Scorer remains unmodified.
operational_review.preserved_legacy: Old v4 freezes remain immutable and run using their saved source revision/package, not this changed observer. Existing v4 ledger is retained separately.
